ex.de: Ich möchte einen Termin für meinen Sohn.
ex.en: I would like an appointment for my son.
ex.ur: Mujhe apne bete ke liye appointment chahiye.

vorsorgetermin.en: routine check-up appointment (the German U1–U9 child check-ups)
vorsorgetermin.ur: check-up ka appointment (bachon ka U1–U9 check-up)

ex.de: Am Donnerstag ist ein Vorsorgetermin frei geworden.
ex.en: A check-up slot became free on Thursday.
ex.ur: Jumeraat ko check-up ka waqt khali hua hai.

vereinbaren.en: to arrange / to agree on (einen Termin vereinbaren = to make an appointment)

ex.en: I would like to make an appointment.
ex.ur: Main appointment lena chahti hoon.
Doctor Weber ka clinic, salam.
Doctor Weber ka bachon ka clinic.

ex.de: Der Arzt kann sich Zeit nehmen.
ex.en: The doctor can take their time.
ex.ur: Doctor waqt de sakta hai.

ex.en: We are going to the pediatrician.
ex.ur: Hum bachon ke doctor ke paas ja rahe hain.
Doctor Weber ka clinic.

sprechstunde.en: consultation hours (when the doctor sees patients)
sprechstunde.ur: clinic ka waqt (jab doctor marizon ko dekhta hai)

ex.de: Die Sprechstunde ist von acht bis zwölf.
ex.en: Consultation hours are from eight to twelve.
ex.ur: Clinic ka waqt aath se barah tak hai.

akutsprechstunde.en: walk-in surgery for urgent cases (no appointment needed)

ex.de: Wir haben eine Akutsprechstunde zwischen acht und zehn Uhr.
ex.en: We have a walk-in surgery between eight and ten.
ex.ur: Aath se das baje tak emergency waqt hota hai.

ex.de: Vor einer Woche waren wir im Notdienst.
ex.en: A week ago we were at the emergency service.
ex.ur: Ek hafta pehle hum emergency gaye thay.

ex.de: Fahren Sie direkt in die Kinderklinik.
ex.en: Drive straight to the children's hospital.
ex.ur: Seedha bachon ke hospital jayein.

behandlung.en: treatment; in Behandlung sein = to be a patient there
behandlung.ur: ilaaj; in Behandlung sein = wahan ilaaj chal raha hona

ex.de: Ist Ihre Tochter schon bei uns in Behandlung?
ex.en: Is your daughter already a patient with us?
ex.ur: Kya aap ki beti pehle se hamare paas ilaaj karwa rahi hai?
Muaina das minute leta hai.
Doctor bache ka muaina karta hai.
Koi ghair mamooli baat nahi mili.

abklären.en: to investigate / to get to the bottom of medically

ex.de: Das sollten wir in Ruhe abklären.
ex.ur: Isay itminan se dekhna chahiye.

abnehmen.en: to take off; Blut abnehmen = to take a blood sample

ex.ur: Khoon liya jata hai.

ex.de: Mein Sohn hat seit zwei Tagen Fieber.
ex.en: My son has had a fever for two days.
ex.ur: Mere bete ko do din se bukhar hai.
Woh saari raat khansta hai.

ex.en: She only has a runny nose.
ex.ur: Us ki sirf naak beh rahi hai.
Dard kab hota hai?

ex.en: She has had an earache since yesterday.
ex.ur: Us ke kaan mein kal se dard hai.

ex.en: He complains about a stomach ache.
ex.ur: Woh pait dard ki shikayat karta hai.

ex.en: My daughter has a sore throat.
ex.ur: Meri beti ke gale mein dard hai.

ex.en: Does he have a headache too?
ex.ur: Kya usay sar dard bhi hai?
Takleef bar qarar hai.

ex.de: So ein Beschwerdetagebuch hilft dem Arzt.
ex.en: Such a symptom diary helps the doctor.
ex.ur: Aisi diary doctor ki madad karti hai.
Kya usay saans lene mein mushkil hai?
Us ki bhook kam hai.
Khoon liya jata hai.
Agar hont neelay ho jayein.
Usay penicillin se allergy hai.
Usay penicillin nahi lagti.

versichertenkarte.en: health insurance card — you need it at every visit
versichertenkarte.ur: insurance card — har visit par zaroori hai

ex.de: Bitte bringen Sie die Versichertenkarte mit.
ex.ur: Meherbani kar ke insurance card layein.

untersuchungsheft.en: the yellow booklet where all child check-ups (U1–U9) are recorded
untersuchungsheft.ur: peela copy jis mein bache ke sab check-up likhe jate hain

ex.de: Bringen Sie das gelbe Untersuchungsheft mit.
ex.ur: Peela check-up copy saath layein.

ex.en: Do you have the vaccination record with you?
ex.ur: Kya teeka card saath hai?
Aaj teeka lagna hai.
Main aap ko nuskha likh deta hoon.

ex.de: Wie oft soll er die Medizin nehmen?
ex.en: How often should he take the medicine?
ex.ur: Usay dawa kitni baar leni hai?

ex.en: What side effects does the medication have?
ex.ur: Is dawa ke kya side effects hain?

ex.de: Die Apotheke ist gleich um die Ecke.
ex.en: The pharmacy is just around the corner.
ex.ur: Pharmacy bilkul qareeb hai.

khan.en: Khan — the family in these conversations

ex.ur: Salam, Khan sahiba.

fatima.en: Fatima — the mother in these conversations

ex.ur: Mera naam Fatima Khan hai.

yusuf.en: Yusuf — the son in these conversations

ex.ur: Us ka naam Yusuf Khan hai.

amina.en: Amina — the daughter in these conversations

ex.ur: Us ka naam Amina Khan hai.

weber.en: Weber — the pediatrician in these conversations
weber.ur: Weber — in guftagu mein bachon ka doctor

ex.ur: Doctor Weber ka clinic.

baumann.en: Baumann — the receptionist in these conversations

ex.ur: Baumann baat kar rahi hoon.
